legend: Alice and Bob are playing a game on an $$$n\times n$$$ grid made of square cells. They play a game and each player wants to paint more cells in their color. Initially, all cells have no color.

In one move, Alice can choose a $$$2 \times 2$$$ empty square and paint all four cells red. None of those four cells can be colored before, and they all must be inside the grid. If there is no available $$$2 \times 2$$$ square, Alice must pass and Bob will keep making moves.
In Bob's move, he can paint one empty cell blue.
They move alternately, Alice goes first. The game stops when all cells are painted (so neither of them can make a move).

If they both play optimally, who will have more cells at the end? Print Alice if there will be strictly more red cells than blue cells; Bob for more blue cells; and Draw if there will be same number of blue and red cells.
You have $$$t$$$ test cases to answer.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ $$$(1 \leq t \leq 1000)$$$, the number of test cases.
The next $$$t$$$ lines contain a single integer $$$n$$$ $$$(1\leq n \leq1000)$$$, the size of the matrix.
output: For each test case, print one line with the answer Alice, Bob or Draw accordingly.
note: This is a possible situation after two full turns for $$$n = 4$$$. Alice then can't make any more moves and Bob will cover all the remaining cells, resulting in a draw 8:8.

legend: 爱丽丝和鲍勃正在一个由正方形单元格组成的 $$$n\times n$$$ 网格上玩游戏。他们玩游戏时，每个玩家都想给更多的单元格涂上自己喜欢的颜色。最初，所有的单元格都没有颜色。
一步之内，Alice 可以选择一个 $$$2 \times 2$$$ 的空方格，并将所有四个方格都涂成红色。这四个方格之前都不能涂色，而且必须都在网格内。如果没有可用的 $$$2 \times 2$$$ 方格，Alice 必须通过，Bob 将继续移动。
在Bob的移动中，他可以将一个空单元格涂成蓝色。
两人交替移动，爱丽丝先走。当所有的单元格都被涂满（因此两人都无法移动）时，游戏停止。
如果他们都发挥最佳，谁会在最后拥有更多的细胞？如果有严格的红色细胞比蓝色细胞多，则打印Alice；如果有相同数量的蓝色细胞和红色细胞，则打印Bob以获得更多的蓝色细胞。
您需要回答 $$$t$$$ 测试案例。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$ $$$(1 \leq t \leq 1000)$$$，测试用例的数量。
接下来的$$$t$$$行包含单个整数$$$n$$$$$$(1\leq n \leq1000)$$$，即矩阵的大小。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印一行，并给出相应的答案 Alice、Bob 或 Draw。
note: 这种情况可能发生在 $$$n = 4$$$ 完成两次完整转动后。届时，爱丽丝将无法再移动，而鲍勃将覆盖所有剩余的方格，导致 8:8 的平局。
